title: Full Stack Software Developer
description: Build end-to-end web applications, master frontend user interfaces, robust backend APIs, and scalable database architectures.
whyMatchesTemplate: Strong proficiency in modern JavaScript/React frameworks.
Aptitude for full-stack system architecture and backend API design.
High market demand with over 45,000+ open positions.

roadmapStages.title: Web Foundations
roadmapStages.description: HTML5, CSS3, Modern JavaScript (ES6+), DOM Manipulation, Responsive Design

roadmapStages.title: Frontend Frameworks
roadmapStages.description: React.js, State Management (Redux/Zustand), Tailwind CSS, REST API integration

roadmapStages.title: Backend Engineering
roadmapStages.description: Node.js, Express.js, Async programming, Database design (MongoDB & PostgreSQL)

roadmapStages.title: DevOps & Tooling
roadmapStages.description: Git version control, Docker containerization, CI/CD pipelines, Cloud Deployment

roadmapStages.title: Full Stack Capstone & Interview Prep
roadmapStages.description: Production full-stack project, System design basics, LeetCode DSA practice

title: Data Analyst
description: Transform complex raw dataset into actionable business insights using SQL, Python, statistics, and interactive BI dashboards.
whyMatchesTemplate: High quantitative assessment score and interest in data analytics.
Strong logical query building skills in SQL and data manipulation.
Fastest growing career path across enterprise organizations.

roadmapStages.title: Data Analytics Fundamentals
roadmapStages.description: Advanced Excel, Descriptive Statistics, Data Cleaning & Preprocessing

roadmapStages.title: Mastering Database Queries
roadmapStages.description: SQL Joins, Aggregations, Window Functions, Database Indexing

roadmapStages.title: Python for Data Analysis
roadmapStages.description: Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn for Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)

roadmapStages.title: Business Intelligence & Dashboards
roadmapStages.description: Power BI / Tableau visual stories, KPI metrics, Automated reporting

roadmapStages.title: Real-World Case Studies
roadmapStages.description: Customer churn analysis, Sales forecasting, A/B testing analytics

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Design, train, and deploy predictive Machine Learning and Deep Learning models into scalable production systems.
whyMatchesTemplate: Exceptional algorithmic problem solving and mathematical background.
Passion for artificial intelligence, computer vision, and NLP.
Top-tier salary packages in modern tech ecosystems.

roadmapStages.title: Python & Math Foundations
roadmapStages.description: Python OOP, Linear Algebra, Calculus, Multivariate Probability

roadmapStages.title: Classic Machine Learning
roadmapStages.description: Supervised/Unsupervised Learning, Regression, Trees, Scikit-Learn

roadmapStages.title: Deep Learning & Neural Nets
roadmapStages.description: Neural Networks, PyTorch/TensorFlow, CNNs, Transformers, LLMs

roadmapStages.title: MLOps & Deployment
roadmapStages.description: FastAPI model wrapping, Docker containerization, Model Monitoring

roadmapStages.title: Production Capstone Project
roadmapStages.description: End-to-end sentiment analyzer or predictive engine deployment

title: Cloud & DevOps Engineer
description: Automate software deployment pipelines, manage resilient cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure), and maintain 99.99% system availability.
whyMatchesTemplate: Strong systemic thinking and interest in automation and server architecture.
Crucial operational role in modern software engineering teams.

roadmapStages.title: Linux & Scripting
roadmapStages.description: Linux CLI, Bash scripting, Networking principles, SSH & Security

roadmapStages.title: Cloud Infrastructure
roadmapStages.description: AWS EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, Azure fundamentals & IAM policy management

roadmapStages.title: Containerization & Orchestration
roadmapStages.description: Docker containers, Kubernetes clusters, Helm charts, Service mesh

roadmapStages.title: Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
roadmapStages.description: Terraform modules, Ansible automation, GitHub Actions CI/CD

roadmapStages.title: Site Reliability Engineering
roadmapStages.description: Prometheus & Grafana monitoring, Security compliance, Incident response

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Protect enterprise networks, conduct vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and respond to security threats.
whyMatchesTemplate: High problem-solving acuity and vigilance for security architecture.
Huge demand due to rising global cybersecurity compliance needs.

roadmapStages.title: Networking & Security Basics
roadmapStages.description: OSI Model, TCP/IP, Cryptography, Wireshark packet capture

roadmapStages.title: Linux & Penetration Testing Tools
roadmapStages.description: Kali Linux, Nmap, Burp Suite, Metasploit basics

roadmapStages.title: Security Operations & SIEM
roadmapStages.description: Log monitoring, Splunk, Incident response playbooks

roadmapStages.title: Certifications & Labs
roadmapStages.description: CompTIA Security+, CEH, TryHackMe & HackTheBox challenges

title: UI/UX Product Designer
description: Design intuitive, visually captivating user interfaces, craft user research journeys, and build interactive Figma prototypes.
whyMatchesTemplate: Creativity combined with empathy for customer product experiences.
Strong eye for visual aesthetics and interactive component hierarchy.

roadmapStages.title: UI Fundamentals
roadmapStages.description: Color theory, Typography, Spacing, Visual Hierarchy, Layout grids

roadmapStages.title: Figma Mastery
roadmapStages.description: Auto-layout, Components, Variants, Interactive Prototyping

roadmapStages.title: UX Research & Journeys
roadmapStages.description: User personas, Wireframing, Usability testing, Information Architecture

roadmapStages.title: Design Systems & Portfolio
roadmapStages.description: Building scalable design libraries and case studies on Behance/Dribbble

title: Product Manager
description: Bridge tech, business, and design teams. Define product roadmap visions, write spec requirements, and launch customer-loved features.
whyMatchesTemplate: High leadership capability and strategic business problem solving.
Excellent communication score matching cross-functional team management.

roadmapStages.title: Product Foundations
roadmapStages.description: Product Lifecycle, PRD Writing, Customer Discovery, Competitor Analysis

roadmapStages.title: Agile Execution
roadmapStages.description: Scrum sprint planning, Jira/Linear, Backlog prioritization (RICE/Kano)

roadmapStages.title: Product Analytics
roadmapStages.description: Mixpanel, Amplitude, Funnel metrics, Retention & Cohort Analysis

roadmapStages.title: Product Strategy & Launch
roadmapStages.description: Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy, Pricing models, Product teardown portfolio

title: Financial Data Analyst
description: Apply statistical analysis, Python, and financial modeling to analyze markets, forecast portfolio risks, and optimize investments.
whyMatchesTemplate: Strong mathematical rigor combined with interest in financial technology.
Blend of corporate finance knowledge and modern programming skills.

roadmapStages.title: Financial Accounting & Valuation
roadmapStages.description: Balance sheets, DCF models, Ratio analysis, Corporate finance

roadmapStages.title: Advanced Financial Modeling in Excel
roadmapStages.description: VBA macros, Sensitivity analysis, LBO & M&A models

roadmapStages.title: Python for Quantitative Finance
roadmapStages.description: Pandas, QuantLib, Monte Carlo simulations, Time series analysis

roadmapStages.title: SQL & Market Data Feeds
roadmapStages.description: Bloomberg terminal fundamentals, SQL database querying for financial feeds
